def solve2(g):
    bgg=g[0][0]; objs=[{'col':c,'cells':set(cells)} for c,cells in comps(g,bgg)]
    Ls=[o for o in objs if is_L(o['cells'])[0]]
    ptr = max(Ls,key=lambda o:len(o['cells'])) if Ls else None
    actors=[o for o in objs if o is ptr or o['col']==0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]; changed=[]
    for a in actors:
        cells=a['cells']; rmax=max(r for r,c in cells)
        cmin=min(c for r,c in cells); cmax=max(c for r,c in cells)
        cands=[]
        for o in objs:
            if o is a: continue
            ormin=min(r for r,c in o['cells'])
            ocmin=min(c for r,c in o['cells']); ocmax=max(c for r,c in o['cells'])
            if ormin>rmax and not(ocmax<cmin or ocmin>cmax):
                cands.append((ormin-rmax-1,o))
        tgt=None
        if cands:
            cands.sort(key=lambda t:t[0]); tgt=cands[0][1]
        elif is_L(cells)[0]:
            _,(jr,jc),nv,nh=is_L(cells)
            vert_dir = 1 if any(r>jr for r,c in cells if c==jc) else -1
            horz_dir = 1 if any(c>jc for r,c in cells if r==jr) else -1
            dd=(-vert_dir,-horz_dir)
            tip=(jr+vert_dir*(nv-1), jc) if nv>=nh else (jr, jc+horz_dir*(nh-1))
            r,c=tip[0]+dd[0],tip[1]+dd[1]
            while 0<=r<len(g) and 0<=c<len(g[0]):
                if g[r][c]!=bgg and (r,c) not in cells:
                    tgt=[o for o in objs if (r,c) in o['cells']][0]; break
                r+=dd[0]; c+=dd[1]
        if tgt is not None:
            for r,c in tgt['cells']: out[r][c]=a['col']
            changed.append((a['col'],len(tgt['cells'])))
    return out,changed

prog = '''def comps(g, bg):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if (r,c) in seen or g[r][c]==bg: continue
            col=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                if (a,b) in seen: continue
                seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<len(g) and 0<=y<len(g[0]) and g[x][y]==col and (x,y) not in seen: st.append((x,y))
            out.append((col,comp))
    return out

def is_L(cells):
    rows=[r for r,c in cells]; cols=[c for r,c in cells]
    for (jr,jc) in cells:
        if all(r==jr or c==jc for r,c in cells):
            nv=sum(1 for r,c in cells if c==jc); nh=sum(1 for r,c in cells if r==jr)
            if nv>=2 and nh>=2: return True,(jr,jc),nv,nh
    return False,None,0,0

def solve2(g):
    bgg=g[0][0]; objs=[{'col':c,'cells':set(cells)} for c,cells in comps(g,bgg)]
    Ls=[o for o in objs if is_L(o['cells'])[0]]
    ptr = max(Ls,key=lambda o:len(o['cells'])) if Ls else None
    actors=[o for o in objs if o is ptr or o['col']==0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for a in actors:
        cells=a['cells']; rmax=max(r for r,c in cells)
        cmin=min(c for r,c in cells); cmax=max(c for r,c in cells)
        cands=[]
        for o in objs:
            if o is a: continue
            ormin=min(r for r,c in o['cells'])
            ocmin=min(c for r,c in o['cells']); ocmax=max(c for r,c in o['cells'])
            if ormin>rmax and not(ocmax<cmin or ocmin>cmax):
                cands.append((ormin-rmax-1,o))
        tgt=None
        if cands:
            cands.sort(key=lambda t:t[0]); tgt=cands[0][1]
        elif is_L(cells)[0]:
            _,(jr,jc),nv,nh=is_L(cells)
            vert_dir = 1 if any(r>jr for r,c in cells if c==jc) else -1
            horz_dir = 1 if any(c>jc for r,c in cells if r==jr) else -1
            dd=(-vert_dir,-horz_dir)
            tip=(jr+vert_dir*(nv-1), jc) if nv>=nh else (jr, jc+horz_dir*(nh-1))
            r,c=tip[0]+dd[0],tip[1]+dd[1]

                r+=dd[0]; c+=dd[1]
        if tgt is not None:
            for r,c in tgt['cells']: out[r][c]=a['col']
    return out

def transform(grid):
    return solve2(grid)

helpers = '''def _comps(g, bg=None):
    if bg is None: bg = g[0][0]
    H, W = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = [[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    out = []
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if seen[r][c] or g[r][c] == bg: continue
            col = g[r][c]; cells = []; st = [(r, c)]; seen[r][c] = True
            while st:
                a, b = st.pop(); cells.append((a, b))
                for da, db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na, nb = a+da, b+db
                    if 0 <= na < H and 0 <= nb < W and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb] == col:
                        seen[na][nb] = True; st.append((na, nb))
            out.append((col, cells))
    return out

def is_L(cells):
    """Return (True, joint, nv, nh) if cells form an L (one vertical + one horizontal arm sharing a joint), else (False, None, 0, 0)."""

    return (False, None, 0, 0)
